question: Every time your neighbor in the adjacent apartment flushes the toilet, the water in your shower becomes very hot, causing you to jump out of the way of the water stream. After this has occurred for several months, you note that you reflexively jump back from the water directly after the sound of the flushing toilet but before the water temperature changes. Which of the following situations is the most similar to the conditioning process detailed above?

options.opa: You consistently check the slots of pay telephones as you have previously found change left there
options.opb: A young child elects to not throw a temper tantrum to avoid being grounded by his parents
options.opc: A mouse repeatedly presses a red button to avoid receiving an electric shock
options.opd: You now sleep through the noise of the train running past your apartment that kept you up 1 year ago
options.ope: White coat syndrome (patient anxiety evoked at the sight of a white lab coat)
